name: OpenLogi Companion
description:
Independent companion for the OpenLogi app: lists the devices reported by the read-only OpenLogi CLI in the panel menu, with connection state and battery.

Requires the OpenLogi app with its `openlogi api devices` CLI and a reachable agent in the same profile. The extension only reads the inventory: it never writes data, never opens HID devices and never talks to the app internals.

Device rows display information only. Use the dedicated menu action to open the general OpenLogi window, then select the device page inside the app. Multiple devices can be pinned to the panel for the current session, each with its own icon and battery shown as a percentage or vertical bar. The extension icon can be hidden while pinned devices are shown.

Unofficial personal project, not affiliated with OpenLogi, Logitech or the GNOME Project.
